Jain previously worked at Cantor Fitzgerald, where he built its technology investment banking group. This hiring coincides with HSBC's strategy to focus on financing areas with greater competitive strength. The bank aims to expand its market share in Asia and the Middle East's tech sectors.

sectors.summary: Cumulative spending globally on data centers alone could top $30 trillion by 2050, according to a projection by PwC, almost matching the value of outstanding US Treasuries. It "dwarfs" what was spent in the railroad or dotcom booms, even after adjusting for inflation, PwC said.
